title: Present Tense for Now and Habits
goal: Form and understand simple Bokmål present-tense statements with regular verbs and er, har, gjør.

objectives.statement: Form and understand simple Bokmål present-tense statements with regular verbs and er, har, gjør.

spans.value: Mina and Jonas share a flat in Bergen. On most weekdays they leave home early, but this Saturday their routines are different.
Fint. Jeg jobber hjemme i dag.

blocks.translation: Good. I’m working from home today.
You usually work at the office.

spans.value: Ja, men jeg har et møte på nettet nå.

blocks.translation: Yes, but I have an online meeting now.

spans.value: Jeg gjør rent på kjøkkenet hver lørdag.

blocks.translation: I clean the kitchen every Saturday.

spans.value: Det er stille her nå, så jeg arbeider godt.

blocks.translation: It’s quiet here now, so I’m working well.

spans.value: Og jeg spiller musikk hver morgen.

blocks.translation: And I play music every morning.

spans.value: The scene contains two kinds of meaning. Some actions are happening now or during the current day: Jonas is making coffee, and Mina is working at home. Other actions are habits: Mina usually works at the office, and Jonas cleans every Saturday.
Norwegian uses the same verb form for both meanings.

prompt.value: Facts: Sara: at home today, working on a computer, usually works at a café on Saturdays. Emil: in the kitchen, has time, making lunch. Write a message to Sara about where they are and what they are doing. Include that Emil has time.

payload.judge_prompt: Evaluate the response only against criteria sara-message-purpose, supplied-facts, and present-forms. Report a separate verdict and evidence for each criterion. Calibration anchors: Must pass: "Hei Sara! Du er hjemme i dag og arbeider på datamaskinen nå. Vanligvis jobber du på kafé på lørdager. Emil er på kjøkkenet. Han har tid og lager lunsj nå." Must fail supplied-facts: "Hei Sara! Du jobber på kafé i dag, og Emil lager middag på kontoret." Must fail present-forms: "Hei Sara! Du er hjemme i dag og jobbe på datamaskinen nå. Vanligvis jobber du på kafé på lørdager. Emil er på kjøkkenet, har tid og lager lunsj."

criteria.instruction: Writes a message to Sara that confirms the described current situation and her usual Saturday routine.
Includes all supplied facts without contradicting them.
Uses natural simple present-tense forms for the described actions.
